encoding: uint16 grey, near = bright, linear in 1/depth: value = 1 + 65534 * (1/d - 1/d_far) / (1/d_near - 1/d_far); 0 = no surface (the view out through the glazing). d = planar depth along the optical axis, metres.
canvas: the canvas of the image; the 16:9 camera frame at frame_box (pixels)
